generation_constraint: Exactly one source_reference image; all style truth is encoded as text and is forbidden generation input.

observations: Five references use polished editorial anime illustration
Opaque print-separated fields and bounded cel-shaded planes recur
Navy focal ink is crisp and selectively detailed
medium_rendering.transferable_rule: Render source-controlled content as a polished editorial anime print illustration with opaque bounded cel-shaded planes and crisp ink, never photorealism.
prompt_clauses: polished editorial anime poster illustration
crisp opaque two-to-three-step cel-shaded planes
screen-print-like color separation and precise deep-navy ink

observations: Teal/cyan, coral/pink/orange, yellow/gold accents vary by image
Contrast is built from flat adjacent value masses
palette_tone.transferable_rule: Use a limited warm-paper and navy-anchored print relationship with adaptable teal/coral/orange/yellow/gold accents, retaining literal source color identity through relative semantic-region treatment.
prompt_clauses: limited warm-paper, deep-navy, teal/cyan, coral/orange, warm-yellow, and restrained muted-gold poster-print relationship
preserve literal source color identity; change only relative value grouping, cel shadows, highlights, contours, and print facets

observed_relative_behavior.value: luminous light plane against a restrained warm shadow
observed_relative_behavior.chroma: controlled warmth, never a fixed complexion
observed_relative_behavior.shading: clean bounded shadow and narrow highlight

skin.source_preserving_transferable_rule: Preserve source skin identity and change only graphic light/shadow/highlight grouping and contour treatment.
prompt_clauses: render visible skin with source-preserved coherent cel-shaded light, shadow, and narrow highlight planes with selective deep-navy contour
never assign a fixed skin tone or change source identity

hair.source_preserving_transferable_rule: Preserve source hair silhouette, arrangement, and literal color while grouping values and adding restrained relative accents.
prompt_clauses: group hair in its source-preserved silhouette and literal color identity into controlled value blocks with restrained relative cool and warm accent planes and tapered navy contour
do not alter hairstyle, hair color, or hair identity

clothing.source_preserving_transferable_rule: Keep every source garment silhouette, construction, marking, logo, and literal color; add only restrained fold-following source-relative print facets.
prompt_clauses: treat clothing as the same source garment: retain silhouette, construction, markings, logos, and literal color identity
add only restrained source-relative flat print facets following existing folds, with dark seam and edge anchors, sparse harmonizing accent edges, and subtle overprint grain
do not replace, redesign, recolor wholesale, obscure, or remove source garments, markings, or logos

observations: Tapered loose strokes and fine ornaments recur
Discs, blocks, rules, brush sweeps, dots, halftones, arcs, and connectors recur in variable arrangements
line_shape.transferable_rule: Use decisive navy ink and an adaptable abstract support vocabulary without fixed geometry.
prompt_clauses: decisive variable-weight deep-navy contours resolving into sparse tapered fine strokes
adaptable abstract discs, blocks, rules, brush sweeps, halftone dots, arcs, and connectors without copied geometry

observations: Warm paper is visible in all references
Screen-print grain, stipple, flecks, broken overprint, or dry brush recur
texture_material.transferable_rule: Use restrained tactile print texture while protecting source legibility.
prompt_clauses: visible warm paper grain with restrained screen-print speckling, imperfect overprint edges, sparse paint flecks, halftone clusters, and occasional dry-brush interruptions
keep texture away from important source details and legible markings

observations: Large support fields precede focal content
Fine gold/ink line and dot ornament completes the hierarchy
graphic_language.transferable_rule: Use adaptable asymmetric poster hierarchy and negative-space rhythm around source-controlled content; typography is conditional on caller text.
prompt_clauses: place broad opaque abstract support fields behind or around source-controlled content, then add sparse fine muted-gold orbital lines, dots, and connectors
retain adaptable negative-space rhythm without copying placement

typography_dialogue.activation: Only when optional text is supplied; otherwise render no text.
typography_dialogue.lettering_or_dialogue_container_medium: Readable high-contrast editorial display ink integrated with the poster-print surface; no dialogue container is required.
typography_dialogue.stroke: Elegant calligraphic/display-like primary stroke with crisp edges and restrained fine detail.
typography_dialogue.hierarchy: Caller text once is the only readable or pseudo-readable lettering and acts as one restrained display accent.
typography_dialogue.orientation: Adaptive for readability; no teacher angle.
typography_dialogue.placement_grammar: Available negative space or a suitable abstract support field, never covering important source content or copying a teacher placement.
typography_dialogue.ornament: Sparse fine dot/line ornament may frame caller text without adding words.
prompt_clauses: only when optional text is supplied, render exactly that verbatim text once as the only readable or pseudo-readable lettering
use readable high-contrast editorial display ink with elegant calligraphic/display-like strokes, adaptive orientation, open-space placement, and sparse dot/line ornament
when text is absent render no text; do not copy teacher wording, script, language, logo, or text placement
